config.efcompat.mode_switching.tooltip: Settings related to automatic switching between vanilla and Epic Fight modes.
config.efcompat.auto_switch_enabled.tool:
Automatically switch to Epic Fight mode when equipping a combat weapon,
and to vanilla mode when equipping a non-combat item.
Respects the 'canSwitchPlayerMode' gamerule.
config.efcompat.use_weapon_category_dete:
Use Epic Fight's WeaponCategory system to auto-detect combat weapons.
This catches modded weapons registered via class hierarchy, regex, or data packs.
When disabled, only Epic Fight's manual config lists are used for detection.
config.efcompat.enforce_mode_on_toggle.t:
Prevent manual mode toggle (default: R key) from switching to an
inappropriate mode. Combat weapon forces Epic Fight, otherwise forces vanilla.
Respects the 'canSwitchPlayerMode' gamerule.
config.efcompat.rendering.tooltip: Settings related to first-person and third-person rendering modifications.
config.efcompat.vanilla_first_person_for:
Use vanilla first-person hand rendering when holding a non-combat item
while in Epic Fight mode. Prevents the Epic Fight animated hand model
from showing for items like torches, food, or blocks.
config.efcompat.punchy_idle_override.too:
When Punchy is installed, let Punchy handle first-person arm rendering
during idle states in Epic Fight combat mode.
Epic Fight retains control during attacks, blocking, and other combat actions.
Punchy features like weapon inspection still work during idle.
